turns.merchant: Three of my products are broken AGAIN and I'm sick of this. Just tell me what to fix.
turns.reply:
Here is an overview of your store's status:
- Account issues: None.
- Disapprovals: 3 products are disapproved due to invalid or placeholder image links.
- Warnings: None.

Here are the details for the disapproved products:

1. HG-006 - "Ceramic Table Lamp, Matte White"
   - Issue: No image link is set.
2. HG-013 - "Walnut Wall Shelf, 24 inch"
   - Issue: The link 'https://cdn.hearthandhollow.example/img/placeholder.png' points to a placeholder image rather than a real product photo.
3. HG-010 - "Soy Wax Candle, Cedar and Smoke, 8 oz"
   - Issue: The image link 'candle-photo.jpg' is not a full web address.

How to fix these issues:
As explained in [Product image link](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324350), every product must have a main image link that is a full web address starting with http:// or https://. The link must point to a real photo of the actual product (at least 500 by 500 pixels) without promotional text, watermarks, or overlays. Placeholder images are not allowed.

Automatic settings cannot fix missing or placeholder images ([Automatic image improvements](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9242973)), so you must update these product image URLs directly in your product data.

Once you update and re-upload your product data, Google will review the items again. These checks usually take 24 to 48 hours ([What happens after you fix a product](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12153802)).

Please let me know if you would like to move on or if you have any questions!

turns.merchant: Why was my lavender massage oil disapproved?
turns.reply:
Here is a quick summary of your account's status:
- Account issues: None.
- Product disapprovals: 1 product is disapproved due to a restricted product policy.
- Warnings: None.

### Disapproved product issue
Your product **"Hemp Extract Massage Oil, Lavender, 100 ml"** (ID: `HG-040`) was disapproved because it mentions hemp extract, which falls under Google's restricted product category for unapproved substances. 

According to [CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956), products involving cannabidiol (CBD) or related unapproved substances are not permitted in Shopping ads or free listings. Because this is a policy decision rather than a product data error, simply editing the product details will not approve it ([CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956)).

If you believe this decision is incorrect and want to challenge it, you can request an appeal. As explained in [Requesting a review or appealing a decision](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13585221), you may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts.

Would you like to request an appeal, or is there anything else you would like to go over?

results.title: Product barcode number (GTIN)
results.passage: A GTIN is the barcode number a manufacturer gives a product, such as a UPC in North America or an EAN in Europe. Google recommends sending it for every product that has one.

results.title: Product barcode number (GTIN)
results.passage: Products with a missing or wrong GTIN may get limited visibility. If a product does have a GTIN and you leave it out, the product could be disapproved.

results.title: Product barcode number (GTIN)
results.passage: Valid GTINs are 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits long. Spaces and dashes are ignored. The last digit is a check digit and must be correct, so copy the number exactly from the packaging or from your supplier.

results.title: Product barcode number (GTIN)
results.passage: Only send a GTIN you are sure is right, and never make one up. Numbers starting with 02, 04 or 2 are restricted, and numbers starting with 05, 98 or 99 are coupon numbers, so neither kind is accepted.

results.title: Product barcode number (GTIN)
results.passage: If a product really has no GTIN, such as a store brand or private label item, do not send one. Send the brand and the manufacturer part number (MPN) instead.

results.title: Products that have no barcode (identifier exists)
results.passage: The identifier exists setting tells Google that a product has no unique product identifiers at all: no GTIN, no MPN and no brand.

results.title: Products that have no barcode (identifier exists)
results.passage: Set it to "no" only for products that truly have none, such as custom made goods, handmade or one of a kind items, and vintage or antique items.

results.title: Products that have no barcode (identifier exists)

results.title: Automatic item updates for price and availability

results.title: Automatic item updates for price and availability

Recommending http/https image URLs, at least 500x500 pixels, showing the actual product without overlays, and noting placeholders are not allowed is supported by 'Product image link' (https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324350). Stating that automatic settings cannot fix missing or placeholder images is supported by 'Automatic image improvements' (https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9242973). Explaining that re-checks usually take 24 to 48 hours after updating and re-uploading product data is supported by 'What happens after you fix a product' (https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12153802).

The claim that products involving CBD or unapproved substances are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings and cannot be fixed by editing product details is supported by cbd-unapproved-substances ('Products on this list are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings' and 'This is a policy decision, not a data problem, so it cannot be fixed by editing product details'). The claim 'you may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts' is supported by request-review ('You may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts').

The policy claims regarding CBD products and the rule that you may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts are supported by cbd-unapproved-substances and request-review. Handing the case off to a specialist is exempt from being treated as advice per the guidelines.

completeness.evidence: Merchant said: "It's a cosmetic oil for the skin and it's sold legally in every shop near me. Please get someone to look at this again." Case correctly recorded: "merchant_request": "The merchant wants to appeal the disapproval of their hemp extract product.", "merchant_reasons": ["It is a cosmetic oil for the skin", "It is sold legally in nearby shops"]. All other criteria (Reason, Issues, What was tried, Next step, No invention) are also fully satisfied.

replies.evidence: Agent stated that CBD is listed as an unapproved substance and products containing CBD are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings, which is supported by cbd-unapproved-substances: 'Google's list of unapproved pharmaceuticals and supplements includes cannabidiol (CBD). Products on this list are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings.' The agent also stated that merchants may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts, which is supported by request-review: 'You may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts'. Passing the case to a specialist and product details are not advice.

completeness.evidence: The merchant stated: "Other shops sell CBD candles on Google Shopping all the time, so why can't I? I want to challenge this decision." The case accurately captures this position in merchant_request ("The merchant wants to challenge the policy disapproval of their CBD candle product.") and merchant_reasons ("Other shops sell CBD candles on Google Shopping all the time, so why can't I?").

replies.evidence: The agent's statement regarding the account issue matches the account store data ("detail": "Misrepresentation: the website is missing a returns policy and business contact details."). The policy rule cited is supported by the Misrepresentation doc: "Google's misrepresentation policy does not allow listings that leave out important information... For example, payment terms, shipping costs and what happens after purchase must be shown clearly before the shopper commits to buy." Transferring the case to a specialist is standard non-advice.

replies.evidence: The statement 'each one needs a main image link that is a full web address starting with http:// or https:// and links directly to a photo showing the actual product' is supported by the Product image link doc ('Every product needs a main image link. Without one the product cannot show. The link must be a full web address that starts with http:// or https://. The image must show the actual product.'). The statement 'automatic image improvements only remove text or overlays from existing photos and cannot fix missing or placeholder images' is supported by Automatic image improvements ('It removes text, watermarks, overlays or logos it detects in the image... Image improvements work on the overlays in an existing image. A missing image or a placeholder needs a real image of the product, added by you.').
The reply only contains facts from the store data (confirming that all 5 products are now active and issues are gone) and an offer to continue helping.
